descricao_original: Cytokinesis completes mitosis and results in the formation of two identical daughter cells, each with one set of paired homologous chromosomes.

marcadores.explicacao_original: Humans have 23 pairs of chromosomes, 22 pairs of autosomes and one pair of sex chromosomes, XX or XY. The full complement of 23 pairs of chromosomes is designated 2N. Note, in this diagram the chromosomes are shown in the condensed state for comparison with the other figures.
